title: introduce-audit-reconciliation-agent-claim-normalizer-and-rbac-suppression
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: several post-incident retros identified gaps where operator-driven reconciliation runs and KMS claim normalization skipped audit emission or produced duplicate/noisy audit entries. This PR adds an Audit Reconciliation Agent (daemon) that performs periodic reconciliation across the event bus, the audit index, and KMS claim records to ensure every sensitive operation has a matching, provenance-tagged audit entry. The agent also includes a KMS Claim Normalizer component to unify claim formats from multiple KMS providers and attach a canonical provenance header. To avoid noisy operator noise during backfills, an RBACv2 Event Suppression Shim prevents transient operator-scoped audit events from being emitted while reconciliation makes historical corrections. Scope: 1) new binary cmd/audit-agent implementing scheduled reconcile loops, heuristic dedupe, and backfill dry-run/commit modes; 2) pkg/kms/claim_normalizer that normalizes provider metadata and emits canonical claim annotations; 3) internal/rbac/suppression_shim to gate emission for reconciliation window and record suppression audit markers; 4) Helm chart and manifests for running as a Kubernetes CronJob or long-running Deployment with low-perf-impact defaults; 5) operator-level feature flag (feature.audit_reconcile=true) and an ops doc describing safe rollout. Checklist: - add reconcile agent with --dry-run and --commit modes - implement KMS claim normalizer with pluggable provider adapters - suppression shim that records suppressed-event placeholders for traceability - add integration tests and a lightweight e2e harness - provide RBAC policies for the agent's service account - document operator rollout steps and failure modes Related: ENG-2021 (linear), SEC-77 (linear), SUP-402 (support ticket). Rollout plan: start in dry-run in staging for 2 weeks, enable commit in canary region, monitor audit gap metrics and reconciliation error budget, then enable wide. Risks/mitigations: potential missing audit duplication mitigated via heuristic dedupe and a reversible commit step; KMS normalization is additive and never replaces original claims; suppression shim records placeholder markers so that audit continuity is preserved.

release_notes: Adds a new Audit Reconciliation Agent to detect and backfill missing audit events, a KMS Claim Normalizer that canonicalizes provider claims, and an RBACv2 suppression shim to prevent noisy duplicate audit emissions during backfills. Operator rollout required: enable feature.audit_reconcile in staging as --dry-run for two weeks, then enable commit in canary. Includes new metrics and docs.
notes: Design decision: normalization is non-destructive; original KMS claim blob is preserved in claim_original field for forensic review
